title: AI Chalk Art Generator
summary: Make chalk art with AI: sidewalk chalk, 3D street art, chalkboard drawings and old master chalk studies. Describe it, pick a chalk style, and Flick draws it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make chalk art with AI?


Describe the drawing, the surface it is on and how the chalk sits there, such as a sidewalk chalk whale on grey asphalt with dusty strokes and broken chalk sticks, then pick a chalk style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the drawing into a clip.


### Can AI make 3D sidewalk chalk art?


Yes. Ask for anamorphic sidewalk chalk art photographed from the one viewpoint where the illusion works, name what opens up in the ground, and let the real paving show at the edges so the trick reads as chalk.


### How do I make a chalkboard drawing with AI?


Ask for white and coloured chalk on a black or green slate board, with soft rubbed shading, crisp highlights and faint erased chalk behind, and add no text, since models tend to fill chalkboards with lettering.


### Can I animate chalk art into a video?


Yes. Generate the chalk drawing first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one gentle motion, such as waves rolling or a beam turning, while asking to keep the chalk texture.


### Is the chalk art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on the free plan. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
